sections.title: Describing Eating Habits and Nutritional Regularity
sections.content: You know the frequency adverbs *mindig*, *gyakran*, *néha* and *ritkán* and the postpositions *előtt* and *után* from A1 Unit 17, and *naponta* (daily) from A2 Unit 1. Use them for habits: *rendszeresen* (regularly), *időnként* (from time to time), *naponta kétszer* (twice a day), *étkezés előtt* (before meals), *vacsora után* (after dinner).

items.english: I regularly eat fruit and vegetables.

items.spanish: Étkezés előtt mindig iszom egy pohár vizet.
items.english: Before meals I always drink a glass of water.
After dinner I rarely eat cake.
